purpose: P1B Sec. IV NaMaster beta-injection pipeline validation rerun at the published-analysis sky fractions: fsky~0.85 (Planck-like) and fsky~0.65 (ACT-DR6-like) galactic-cut masks, same apodization recipe (2-deg smoothing) and same synthetic-LCDM + 10 uK-arcmin noise MC method as the canonical fsky=0.32 run.
scope_note: Pipeline-recovery validation on synthetic skies (mirrors reproducibility/p1_namaster_500mc/scripts/namaster_500mc.py); NOT a sky measurement. SNR^SE = beta_hat*sqrt(N)/sigma_beta is the estimator-calibration metric of P1B fn:snr_definition.
